profile.name: 通用实验仪器控制模块
profile.description: 这是一个面向实验室数据采集与运动控制系统的通用控制模块，用于统一管理探测器和执行器类仪器的初始化、采集触发、停止、数据保存和状态更新。根据现有证据，它并不对应某一特定物理仪器，而是用于实验自动化平台中的通用仪器控制组件。
profile.description_en: This is a generic control module for laboratory data acquisition and motion-control systems. It is used to manage detector- and actuator-type instruments, including hardware initialization, acquisition triggering, stopping, data saving, and status updates. Based on the available evidence, it does not correspond to a single specific physical instrument, but rather to a general instrument-control component used in lab automation.
